title: The Single Thread — Supply Chain Fragility
context: Procurement consolidates 80% of rare earth component sourcing to a single low-cost supplier in a geopolitically unstable region to reduce unit costs by 23%.

Agent_Alpha_Linear.claim: Supplier consolidation reduces unit costs by 23% if geopolitical conditions remain stable

Agent_Beta_HSP.counter_claim: Single-supplier dependency causes catastrophic production halt if geopolitical disruption occurs within 36-month window

resolution_criteria.success_metric: Expected total procurement cost (unit savings minus weighted disruption losses)
